question: What is one major benefit of electronic communication in nursing?

options.A: It eliminates all forms of human error
options.B: It improves the speed and accuracy of information sharing
options.C: It completely replaces the need for bedside nursing care
options.D: It removes any requirement for data privacy laws

explanation: Electronic communication enhances the speed and accuracy of information sharing across healthcare teams. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h1)

question: Which of the following is a potential challenge associated with digital communication in healthcare?

options.A: Excessive non-verbal cue availability
options.B: Risk of data privacy concerns and misinterpretation
options.C: Complete elimination of geographical gaps
options.D: Immediate resolution of all technical hurdles

explanation: Digital communication introduces challenges such as data privacy concerns and potential misinterpretations due to missing non-verbal cues. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h1)

question: What is a key characteristic of individual electronic communication in nursing?

options.A: It always takes place in large public forums
options.B: It involves one-on-one digital exchanges between professionals or with a patient
options.C: It never requires confidentiality safeguards
options.D: It replaces all verbal handovers permanently

explanation: Individual communication involves one-on-one digital exchanges like secure messaging between a nurse and a physician or patient. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h2)

question: Why is clarity and professionalism especially critical in individual electronic messages?

options.A: They always lack tone of voice and facial expressions
options.B: They are automatically deleted after five minutes
options.C: They are only used for casual social conversations
options.D: They cannot be used as legal records

explanation: Electronic messages lack non-verbal cues like tone and facial expressions, making clarity and professional phrasing vital to avoid misunderstandings. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h2)

question: Which of the following is a primary use of group communication in nursing?

options.A: Private counseling for a single patient
options.B: Shift handovers and multidisciplinary clinical rounds
options.C: Hiding patient data from other healthcare providers
options.D: Eliminating all forms of team collaboration

explanation: Group communication platforms are commonly used for shift handovers, team meetings, and multidisciplinary rounds. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h3)

question: What is a common risk associated with poorly managed digital group communication?

options.A: Enhanced physical fitness among staff
options.B: Alert fatigue and missed critical updates due to irrelevant chatter
options.C: Automatic encryption of all messages
options.D: Guaranteed 100% patient compliance

explanation: Too much irrelevant chatter in group chats can cause alert fatigue, leading members to miss important updates. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h3)

question: What is a major advantage of video conferencing over text-based messaging?

options.A: It requires zero internet bandwidth
options.B: It restores non-verbal cues like facial expressions and body language
options.C: It completely prevents any possibility of data breaches
options.D: It can only be used for entertainment purposes

explanation: Video conferencing brings back visual and auditory non-verbal cues such as body language and facial expressions. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h4)

question: Which practice is considered proper netiquette during a professional nursing video conference?

options.A: Keeping your microphone unmuted at all times
options.B: Ignoring your surrounding physical environment
options.C: Muting your microphone when not speaking to reduce background noise
options.D: Eating heavy meals while the camera is active

explanation: Muting your microphone when not speaking helps minimize disruptive background noise during the conference. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h4)

question: Which Zoom feature is particularly useful for small group discussions in nursing education?

options.A: Breakout rooms
options.B: Zoombombing
options.C: Automatic patient diagnosis
options.D: Physical EHR integration

explanation: Breakout rooms allow hosts to split large meetings into smaller groups for focused discussions and activities. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h5)

question: How can meeting hosts prevent unauthorized access or disruptions on Zoom?

options.A: Share the meeting link publicly on social media
options.B: Disable all passwords and waiting rooms
options.C: Use security features like waiting rooms and password protection
options.D: Allow all participants to share their screens simultaneously

explanation: Waiting rooms and passwords help control entry and prevent unauthorized individuals from disrupting the session. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h5)

question: What is a key advantage of Google Meet's integration with Google Workspace?

options.A: It automatically prints paper documents
options.B: It allows seamless scheduling and instant document sharing via Google Drive
options.C: It removes the need for an internet connection
options.D: It replaces the need for nursing documentation

explanation: Google Workspace integration allows easy calendar scheduling and instant document sharing through Google Drive. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h6)

question: Why is Google Meet advantageous in areas with varying internet connectivity like Nigeria?

options.A: It only operates on high-end mainframe computers
options.B: It has accessibility across various devices including smartphones and tablets
options.C: It requires no data or network service
options.D: It downloads the entire internet onto your device

explanation: Google Meet is accessible across multiple devices like smartphones and tablets, supporting users with different mobile setups. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h6)

question: What makes Microsoft Teams unique as a collaboration platform in healthcare?

options.A: It only allows single-person video calls
options.B: It combines video conferencing, persistent chat, file storage, and app integration in one hub
options.C: It is exclusively used for playing video games
options.D: It deletes all shared files after 24 hours

explanation: Microsoft Teams integrates video, chat, file storage, and applications into a single comprehensive hub. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h7)

question: How do dedicated channels in Microsoft Teams benefit nursing units?

options.A: They keep discussions organized by specific shifts, departments, or projects
options.B: They automatically write nursing care plans for patients
options.C: They prevent any communication from ever being saved
options.D: They restrict access to only one person per hospital

explanation: Dedicated channels help keep discussions organized around specific topics, shifts, or clinical projects. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h7)

question: What is Skype primarily classified as?

options.A: An electronic health record database
options.B: A Voice over IP (VoIP) and video chat platform
options.C: An automated medication dispenser
options.D: A surgical instrument sterilizer

explanation: Skype is primarily known as a Voice over IP (VoIP) and video chat platform for voice and video communication. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h8)

question: What caution should nurses exercise when using Skype in clinical practice?

options.A: Evaluating its security features against institutional compliance standards for patient data
options.B: Using it exclusively for open-heart surgeries
options.C: Requiring patients to pay in foreign currency
options.D: Turning off all video and audio capabilities

explanation: Nurses must ensure Skype meets healthcare security and compliance standards before using it to transmit sensitive health information. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h8)

question: What type of platform is Moodle?

options.A: A real-time surgical robot controller
options.B: A Learning Management System (LMS) for online education
options.C: A patient billing and insurance software
options.D: A social media app for photo sharing

explanation: Moodle is a Learning Management System (LMS) used to manage and deliver online educational courses. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h9)

question: How does Moodle primarily support nursing students in their studies?

options.A: By providing a portal for course content, assignments, quizzes, and discussion forums
options.B: By diagnosing patient illnesses automatically in the hospital ward
options.C: By replacing all clinical bedside training permanently
options.D: By offering live streaming of entertainment movies

explanation: Moodle provides students with access to course materials, assignments, quizzes, and academic discussion forums. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h9)

question: What is a key best practice for nurses when handling digital patient information?

options.A: Sharing passwords with colleagues to speed up work
options.B: Avoiding unsecured personal messaging apps for identifiable patient data
options.C: Posting patient case studies on public social media without consent
options.D: Leaving computer workstations logged in and unattended

explanation: Nurses must avoid transmitting identifiable patient data over unsecured personal messaging applications to protect privacy. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h10)

question: Why should nurses maintain professional boundaries on social media regarding patients?

options.A: To prevent compromising patient confidentiality and professional integrity
options.B: To ensure patients pay their hospital bills on time
options.C: To increase the number of online followers they have
options.D: To eliminate the need for electronic health records

explanation: Maintaining digital boundaries prevents breaches of patient confidentiality and preserves the professional nurse-patient relationship. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h10)
